history.title: Sync History
history.subtitle: Track your bookmark changes and device sync activity
history.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all sync history?
history.chartSubtitle: Sync frequency and data changes in the last 7 days

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.subtitle: Appearance and language preferences
appearance.notificationsDesc: Show system notifications after sync completes
appearance.telemetryDesc: Send crash reports and performance data to help improve the extension

syncStrategy.title: Sync Strategy
syncStrategy.subtitle: Configure sync frequency and automation behavior
syncStrategy.deviceNameDesc: Device identifier for tracking change sources
syncStrategy.autoSyncDesc: Automatically sync data in the background at regular intervals
syncStrategy.syncIntervalDesc: Pro users can choose high-frequency sync (as fast as 5 minutes)
syncStrategy.formatJsonDesc: Make remote JSON files more readable
syncStrategy.conflictStrategyDesc: When local and remote are modified simultaneously and cannot be automatically identified, this strategy will be used

encryption.description: Uses industry-standard AES-GCM algorithm to encrypt bookmark data uploaded to remote storage, protecting user data privacy.
encryption.warning1: Note: After enabling encryption, you need to set a password for encrypting and decrypting bookmark data.
encryption.warning2: The password is saved locally. If the password is lost, bookmark data cannot be recovered.
encryption.warning3: If you change the password, you need to manually delete the remote bookmark data file and then re-sync (re-upload to remote).

safety.description: Block and require manual confirmation when sync would cause mass deletion of local bookmarks
safety.thresholdNote: Note: Protection is only triggered when deletion count is greater than 10 and ratio exceeds the set value.

syncRecord.title: Sync Record Settings
syncRecord.subtitle: Manage retention policy for sync history and bookmark snapshots
syncRecord.maxSnapshotsDesc: Older snapshots exceeding this number will be automatically cleaned up to save space (sync history will still keep the last 100 entries).

storage.title: Storage Service
storage.subtitle: Store your bookmark data
storage.selectDesc: Select and configure the backend service used for syncing bookmarks

github.title: GitHub Repository Configuration
github.description: Leverage Git's version control capabilities to track history changes of bookmarks
github.tokenNote: Click the button on the right to quickly create a Token (Classic Token recommended), ensure it includes 'repo' scope.

webdav.title: WebDAV Configuration
webdav.description: WebDAV is a standard protocol, not dependent on any specific platform. Supports various cloud storage, NAS (Synology, QNAP), Jianguoyun, Nextcloud, etc.
webdav.passwordNote: Highly recommended to use an 'App Password' instead of your main account password.

gist.title: GitHub Gist Configuration
gist.description: Simpler and faster than a full repository, no need to create a dedicated code repo. Direct access via Gist ID.
gist.tokenNote: Token used to access Gists, ensure 'gist' scope is checked.

gitee.title: Gitee Repository Configuration
gitee.description: Fastest access in China, based on Gitee Open Platform
gitee.tokenNote: Click the button on the right to quickly create a Token, ensure 'projects' and 'pull_requests' scopes are included.

gitlab.title: GitLab Configuration
gitlab.description: Integrate GitLab repository storage, supports self-hosted instances
gitlab.tokenPlaceholder: Enter your GitLab personal access token

googledrive.title: Google Drive Configuration
googledrive.description: Store data in Google Drive with revision history support

dropbox.title: Dropbox Configuration
dropbox.description: Stable and efficient cross-border sync service

onedrive.title: OneDrive Configuration
onedrive.description: Microsoft cloud storage, perfectly integrated with Windows ecosystem

s3.title: S3 Compatible Storage Configuration
s3.description: Supports AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Alibaba Cloud OSS, etc.
s3.endpointNote: Leave blank for AWS S3. Required for MinIO, R2, etc.
s3.forcePathStyleDesc: Required for MinIO or some S3 compatible services

bookmarkBackup.title: Backup Bookmarks
bookmarkBackup.description: Backup or migrate bookmarks using local JSON files
bookmarkBackup.importWarning: Warning: Importing will clear and overwrite all your current browser bookmarks. This operation is irreversible. It is recommended to export a backup first. Continue?

settingsBackupLocal.title: Backup Settings Locally
settingsBackupLocal.description: Export or import extension configuration and credentials
settingsBackupLocal.importWarning: Are you sure you want to overwrite current settings? This may change your sync credentials. Continue importing?
settingsBackupLocal.importSuccess: Settings imported successfully, page will reload
settingsBackupLocal.decompressError: Decompression failed, file may be corrupted

settingsBackupCloud.title: Backup Settings to Cloud
settingsBackupCloud.description: Save or restore plugin configuration and credentials in the cloud. After changing browsers or reinstalling the system, you can quickly restore the configuration.
settingsBackupCloud.uploadWarning: Warning: This will overwrite the cloud-saved configuration with your current local configuration. Continue uploading?
settingsBackupCloud.downloadWarning: Warning: This will overwrite your current local configuration with the cloud configuration, and this operation cannot be undone! Continue downloading?
settingsBackupCloud.downloadSuccess: Settings downloaded successfully, page will reload
settingsBackupCloud.downloadNoData: Download failed or no configuration data in cloud

dangerous.title: Dangerous Operations
dangerous.description: These operations will permanently delete data, please use with caution
dangerous.clearLocalWarning: Warning: This will delete all bookmark content in the browser (excluding system reserved folders). This operation is irreversible, please ensure you have a backup. Continue deleting?
dangerous.deleteRemoteWarning: Warning: This will attempt to delete the sync data file from the cloud. This operation will prevent other devices from syncing this data. Continue deleting?
dangerous.deleteRemoteNotSupported: This storage method does not support online deletion
dangerous.resetSettingsWarning: Are you sure you want to reset all local settings? This will overwrite all current settings and restore to default state.

about.title: BookmarkSync
about.description: An open-source, secure, and fully self-controlled cross-browser bookmark sync solution.

multiSync.title: Multi-Device Sync
multiSync.description: Supports multiple backends like GitHub, WebDAV, Gist for seamless cross-device experience.

privacy.title: Privacy & Security
privacy.description: Supports end-to-end encryption, all data is under your control, we cannot read your bookmarks.

smartMerge.title: Smart Merge
smartMerge.description: Uses multi-way merge algorithm to intelligently handle conflicts and ensure bookmark data consistency.

easyToUse.title: Easy to Use
easyToUse.description: Carefully designed UI makes complex sync configuration simple and intuitive.

support.title: Support Continuous Development
support.description: BookmarkSync is an open-source project maintained by individual developers. Your support is the greatest motivation for continuous updates.
support.thanksDescription: Thanks to all users who submitted code, reported bugs, and provided suggestions. Also thanks to excellent open-source projects like lucide-react, shadcn/ui for their help.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: System health and status overview
dashboard.forceSyncDesc: Resolve conflicts or initialize data (extreme measure)
dashboard.confirmForcePush: Are you sure you want to force push? This will overwrite cloud data with your local bookmarks.
dashboard.confirmForcePull: Are you sure you want to force pull? This will clear all local bookmarks and overwrite them with cloud data.

history.title: Sync Stats & Logs
history.subtitle: Track local bookmark change trends and sync details
history.confirmClear: Are you sure you want to clear all local sync history? This cannot be undone.
history.statsAddedDesc: Newly added bookmarks in recent 100 syncs
history.statsDeletedDesc: Removals due to merge or manual deletion
history.chartSubtitle: Shows daily sync frequency and total changes

timemachine.title: Bookmark Time Machine
timemachine.subtitle: View and restore historical versions of bookmarks
timemachine.unsupportedDesc: Due to {{storageType}} protocol lacking standard native version control API, Time Machine is currently only supported for {{supportedStorageType}}.
timemachine.unsupportedButton: Go to Storage Settings to Switch
timemachine.noHistoryDesc: Only successful syncs from this storage method will appear here
timemachine.confirmRestore: Are you sure you want to restore bookmarks to the version from {{date}}?
